semantic_evidence.authoritative_route: CurveRegionBooleanContext admits BezierAlgebraicChord2 directly as a line-family carrier. Binary Boolean, unary regularization, intersection evidence, broad phase, split topology, fragment classification, and output materialization continue through the existing CurveRegion2 arrangement authority.
semantic_evidence.disjoint_pairs: Conservative exact chord bounds participate in the existing broad phase. Bounds-disjoint pairs complete without constructing an intersection system and preserve the retained chord through all four Boolean outputs.
semantic_evidence.adjacent_exact_line: For adjacent authored carriers, direct exact/algebraic endpoint-side predicates prove distinct supporting lines. Certified injectivity makes the already-seeded common endpoint the only possible contact.
semantic_evidence.adjacent_source_curve: For a one-field chord/source pair, the exact homogeneous supporting-line incidence is formed over the selected source field. Hypersolve removes the known diagonal endpoint root and counts the remaining closed-domain roots with a local-field Sturm sequence. Only a residual count of zero completes the pair.
semantic_evidence.split_and_output: An unsplit algebraic chord retains local range [0,1] and traversal orientation. Any interior cut remains an explicit topology error until algebraic chord/contact parameter materialization lands; no event is discarded.
semantic_evidence.classification: Binary fragment classification uses a represented chord endpoint when available and otherwise the existing algebraic point classifier. Unary topology normally propagates classification across the certified adjacent run.
semantic_evidence.strict_policy: STRICT uses only proof-producing bounds, line-side, field-identity, diagonal-deflation, Sturm-count, injectivity, connectivity, and topology paths. Unproved overlap, collinearity, independent-field incidence, or interior splitting remains blocked.
semantic_evidence.approximate_512_policy: APPROXIMATE_512 executes the same graph. Hypercurve observes Hypersolve approximate certainty explicitly, while scalar predicate fallbacks remain limited to the shared Hyperlimit 512-bit equality terminal.
